description: paper_configs_v2: GPT-2 large spline vs linear feature-match (d_t=5120) at 1B tokens, single seed, following the gpt2-small 1b_v3 recipe (grid refine DISABLED, deduped train-disjoint val). Sized for one 2-node x 2-GPU FSDP job: per-rank batch 32 = global 128 sequences/step, so 1B tokens x 0.95 / (128 x 128 tokens) = 58000 steps. Collection chunks reduced to 4M tokens because gpt2-large activations are ~184 KB/token (36 layers x 1280 dims x in+out x bf16), keeping each per-node /lscratch chunk near ~740 GB.
